links.outcome: Sperm detection model precision and recall across clinics and imaging setups in multi-center validation
links.effect: After training on a dataset enriched with varied imaging conditions, multi-center validation showed no significant differences in precision or recall across clinics and applications. Internal ICC was 0.97 for both precision and recall.
links.quote: Multi-center clinical validation showed no significant differences in model precision or recall across different clinics and applications.

unlisted_practices: Enriching training data with diverse imaging magnifications, imaging modes, and sample preprocessing protocols to improve reproducibility across clinics

screen.reason: Evaluates how training dataset diversity and multi-center variability affect model generalizability and cross-clinic reproducibility.

primary.practice: multi-center diverse dataset enrichment for cross-site reproducibility
